limitations: Canvas/WebGL text, cross-origin frame content, native browser chrome, and OS-native dialogs are not captured.
Closed shadow roots cannot be inspected.
Only the currently rendered state is captured; exercise other states separately.
Ordinary input values and sensitive-looking attributes/JSON keys are deliberately omitted.
Use sanitized test data: arbitrary text nodes or data attributes can still contain private product data.

The v2-conditional-mobile DOM capture contains baseline strings and a 0 B counter; it does not evidence active dialog or validation wording. Clipboard failure is captured separately in v2-copy-fallback-mobile.
